source_snapshot.criteria: Logo is clear, has no spelling error and matches the customer's requirement.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes a login-page screenshot but does not bind BMC/build/reference/matrix or protect screenshot data.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; adds exact endpoint, approved reference, fixed viewport, redaction and owner judgment.

old_problem: The test purpose, browser observation and human verdict boundary were already clear, but the absent customer asset and rendering matrix were treated as an engineering-decision dependency instead of ordinary Project Configuration.
disposition_reason: There is no public standard that can define this customer's intended logo. The authoritative package is the approved logo asset/hash, brand guide, exact wordmark and rendering matrix. Once supplied, automation can bind the capture to the exact BMC/UI build and produce reproducible screenshots, OCR and image measurements, while an authorized customer/engineer decides clarity and design conformance. ED-08 requires the real WebUI evidence and ED-36 allows the absent endpoint/reference/matrix as prerequisites, so the record can leave Pending without fabricating a logo or verdict.
decision_basis: XLSX row 839, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2 and historical record were directly reviewed.
The source consistently asks for a visual BMC-web logo check; it contains no competing method or target.
Customer-specific brand correctness can only be judged against a versioned Project authority, not a generic web or OEM assumption.

ED-08 mandates genuine WebUI visual evidence, ED-15 forbids an unapproved similarity threshold from deciding PASS, and ED-20 preserves this Source Key/Variant even if other UI cases reuse the same page.

test_case.test_name: Compare the rendered BMC Web logo with the customer-approved branding package
test_case.purpose: On the exact intended BMC web UI, verify the rendered logo is clear, contains the approved correctly spelled wordmark and matches the customer-approved asset, proportions, colors, placement and responsive presentation in every required display context.
required_package: BMC endpoint/certificate, device identity, firmware and WebUI bundle/build/hash plus exact public/authenticated page locations
Customer-approved lossless logo asset with hash, brand-guide/version, expected wordmark/spelling, colors, aspect ratio, placement and minimum-size/contrast rules
Required browser/version, viewport/resolution, device-pixel ratio, zoom, theme, language and responsive-state matrix
Approved OCR, pixel/perceptual, clipping, contrast and rendering tolerances plus rules for human adjudication
Isolated browser/session, screenshot redaction/storage policy and authorized customer/engineer reviewer
test_case.test_command: Validate the BMC certificate/device and firmware/UI build, start an isolated supported browser, and load each approved page/matrix cell without changing BMC configuration. Record browser, viewport, device scale, zoom, theme and language; capture a lossless redacted full-page screenshot and reproducible logo crop. Compare asset dimensions/aspect ratio/color/placement, OCR the exact approved wordmark, generate overlay/difference evidence and inspect clipping, blur and scaling. Present raw and annotated images to the authorized reviewer for the separate clarity/spelling/customer-design verdict. Close the isolated session and verify no state changed; do not clear logs, upload branding or silently omit matrix cells.
test_case.expected_result: Every required page/context shows the logo tied to the approved asset and wordmark, with no spelling defect, clipping, distortion, unintended blur, color/contrast/placement violation or unacceptable rendering difference under the approved tolerances. Full-page and cropped visual evidence is free of secrets, the authorized reviewer confirms clarity and customer-design match, and BMC configuration remains unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact BMC/UI identity, full evidence for every required matrix cell, objective asset/OCR/layout checks within approved tolerances, and an authorized visual acceptance. A screenshot alone, OCR alone, pixel score alone or one arbitrary viewport cannot pass. Wrong target/build, missing/incorrect wordmark, mismatch outside tolerance, clipping/blur/poor contrast, contaminated evidence or reviewer rejection is FAIL. Missing customer asset/guide, matrix, tolerances or reviewer is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS.
safety_gate: Observation only: do not upload, replace, restyle or configure any branding or firmware.
Verify endpoint/certificate/device/build before capture; a correct logo from another BMC is invalid evidence.
Use an isolated session and exclude/redact credentials, tokens, cookies, account names and unrelated sensitive page data.
Do not clear logs or automatically recapture after a wrong-target/sensitive screenshot; quarantine it and revalidate the setup first.
Do not let OCR or similarity metrics issue the customer verdict or invent unapproved thresholds.
Report every untested page/viewport/theme/language cell explicitly; absence of evidence is not PASS.
expected_evidence: BMC certificate/device, firmware/UI build and exact page identity
Approved logo asset hash, brand-guide/version, expected wordmark and complete acceptance matrix/tolerances
Lossless redacted full-page and reproducible logo crops with browser/version, viewport, device scale, zoom, theme, language and timestamp
OCR result, dimension/aspect/color/contrast/placement measurements and overlay/difference output per matrix cell
Annotated clipping, blur, spelling or branding findings and explicit untested cells
Authorized customer/engineer visual verdict and proof no BMC configuration changed
test_case.recovery: No configuration recovery should be needed. If the endpoint/build is wrong or sensitive data appears, stop, close the isolated session, restrict/quarantine or delete the contaminated evidence according to the approved data-handling policy, validate the target/redaction setup and obtain confirmation before a new capture. Do not modify the BMC to repair the logo under this test.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define a visual customer-branding check.

blocked.reason: The visual checkpoints are defined; customer asset, matrix, thresholds and reviewer are readiness inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: BMC/UI identity, approved logo asset/brand guide, rendering matrix/tolerances, redaction policy and authorized reviewer.

project_authority: The versioned customer-approved logo asset and brand guide are the sole design authority; no external public source was substituted.
